# Ahmad Faruqui

Ahmad Faruqui is an economist and consultant known for his work in the energy sector, particularly in electricity pricing and demand response.

## Professional Background

- **Energy Economist** specializing in electricity markets, rate design, and demand-side management
- Has worked as a principal at **The Brattle Group**, a consulting firm
- Previously held positions at **EPRI** (Electric Power Research Institute) and other energy consulting organizations

## Areas of Expertise

- **Dynamic pricing** of electricity (time-of-use rates, critical peak pricing)
- **Smart grid** economics and policy
- **Demand response** programs and their effectiveness
- Utility rate design and regulatory economics

## Publications and Contributions

- Author or co-author of numerous papers on electricity pricing
- Has published studies on the price elasticity of electricity demand
- Contributed to research on how consumers respond to time-varying electricity rates

## Other Interests

- Has also written on topics related to **Pakistan**, including defense, security, and economic issues
- Contributed commentary and analysis to various publications on South Asian affairs

## Education

- Holds advanced degrees in economics
